bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to insurance; setting requirements for calculating an enrollee's contribution toward an out-of-pocket maximum or cost sharing; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 62Q.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[+[62Q.491] CALCULATION OF ENROLLEE CONTRIBUTION TOWARD AN OUT-OF-POCKET MAXIMUM OR COST-SHARING REQUIREMENT. +]

[+(a) To the extent permitted by federal law, a health plan company must include any amounts paid by the enrollee or paid on behalf of the enrollee by another person when calculating an enrollee's overall contribution toward any out-of-pocket maximum or cost-sharing requirement under a health plan. +]

[+(b) For purposes of this section, "cost sharing" means any co-payment, coinsurance, or deductible. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section applies to health plans offered, issued, or renewed on or after January 1, 2026. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to insurance; setting requirements for calculating an enrollee's contribution toward an out-of-pocket maximum or cost sharing; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 62Q.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[62Q.491] CALCULATION OF ENROLLEE CONTRIBUTION TOWARD AN OUT-OF-POCKET MAXIMUM OR COST-SHARING REQUIREMENT.

(a) To the extent permitted by federal law, a health plan company must include any amounts paid by the enrollee or paid on behalf of the enrollee by another person when calculating an enrollee's overall contribution toward any out-of-pocket maximum or cost-sharing requirement under a health plan.

(b) For purposes of this section, "cost sharing" means any co-payment, coinsurance, or deductible.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section applies to health plans offered, issued, or renewed on or after January 1, 2026.
additions: [62Q.491] CALCULATION OF ENROLLEE CONTRIBUTION TOWARD AN OUT-OF-POCKET MAXIMUM OR COST-SHARING REQUIREMENT.

(a) To the extent permitted by federal law, a health plan company must include any amounts paid by the enrollee or paid on behalf of the enrollee by another person when calculating an enrollee's overall contribution toward any out-of-pocket maximum or cost-sharing requirement under a health plan.
(b) For purposes of this section, "cost sharing" means any co-payment, coinsurance, or deductible.
This section applies to health plans offered, issued, or renewed on or after January 1, 2026.
